pra_category: Own funds, capital requirements and RWA
description: Own funds, capital adequacy, capital ratios, capital buffers, risk-weighted assets and capital requirements.
Leverage ratio, Tier 1 leverage capital and leverage exposure measure.
Balance sheet, profit or loss, income, expenses, earnings and financial performance.
Credit quality, impairment, expected credit losses, provisions, non-performing exposures, arrears, forbearance and related credit-risk information.
Single-name, connected-client, sectoral, geographic and other concentration or large-exposure risk.
Counterparty credit risk from derivatives, securities-financing transactions, margining, collateral, CVA and related exposures.
Securitisation positions, structures, capital treatment and related risk exposures.
Trading-book market risk, market-risk capital requirements, value-at-risk or expected shortfall frameworks and related exposures.
Operational-risk exposures and capital requirements. This does not automatically include all conduct, complaints or cyber narrative.
Liquidity Coverage Ratio, high-quality liquid assets, liquidity buffer, contractual inflows and outflows and short-term liquidity resilience.
Net Stable Funding Ratio, available stable funding, required stable funding and structural funding profile.

description: Funding concentration, funding maturity, rollover, funding pricing, currency mismatch, liquidity monitoring and counterbalancing capacity.
Encumbered and unencumbered assets, collateral, secured funding and asset encumbrance.

description: Economic value of equity, net interest income sensitivity, interest-rate shocks and banking-book interest-rate risk.

description: Forecast capital, stress testing, management buffers, capital plans, dividend or buyback capacity and capital actions.
Cash-flow mismatch, internal liquidity stress and Pillar 2 liquidity-related monitoring.
Global systemically important institution indicators, scoring, buckets and systemic buffers.

description: Risk-management objectives and policies, governance, regulatory scope, consolidation and reconciliation disclosures.
